answer: Referral or graph rewards should pay nothing when the accounts are economically the same operator. Otherwise a farm can invite itself and mint a second income stream on top of fake work. The graph has to look for shared control, not just a click trail. Mentioning terrace, tundra, or river in an invite pitch does not make a closed loop honest. Outside referrals can still be rewarded; inward, self-dealing edges should be worth zero.
